title: Anomalous Price Change Dates
scenario: Find price changes that occurred on a weekend (Saturday/Sunday).
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM ...) where 6 is Sat and 7 is Sun.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, change_date FROM products WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM change_date) IN (6, 7);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
